title: anim.press_ack/1
description: data/anim/press_ack.json: the anticipation of a press that has to wait (docs/animation/press-ack.md; AnimFighter's press_ack layer): Encounter's cue press_ack names the button cell (x a light, y a heavy, b the big press); the layer eases the cell's pose in over enter_ticks, holds it at most max_ticks, and lets go over exit_ticks. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-reference in tools/lib/xref-fight.js (anim-press-ack-pose: every pose named exists in a wave's poses).

enter_ticks.description: Ticks the pose takes to ease in.

exit_ticks.description: Ticks the pose takes to let go.

max_ticks.description: The longest an acknowledgement is held, in ticks.

min_wait.description: The shortest wait, in ticks, for which a press is acknowledged at all.

pose.description: A pose id of a wave (ak.<sequence>.<phase>): rule anim-press-ack-pose.

w.description: How far the pose is mixed in at the top of the ramp, 0 to 1.
